Name: Stardew Valley Map Teleport
Author: Hypnoz0911
Description:
这是一个星露谷地图传送模组，在地图页面左键点击带有名称的地点即可传送，基于[url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]Aedenthorn的模组[/url]修改而来，适配星露谷1.6版本。

This is a Stardew Valley map teleportation mod that allows you to teleport to named locations on the map by left-clicking them. It is based on [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]Aedenthorn's mod[/url] and is compatible with Stardew Valley version 1.6.

Manifest.Name: MapTeleport
Manifest.Description: Teleport on the map with one click.
Manifest.Author: Richard2091
